question: Which of the following trophy is associated with women's Badminton?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uber Cup**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Uber Cup** is a prestigious** international women's badminton tournament** that takes place **every two years.**
 
• It was **first held in 1956** and is **named after Betty Uber**, a former English badminton player who was instrumental in the development of the tournament.
 
• It is one of the oldest and most respected women's international team competitions in the world of sports.
 
• The tournament features teams from all over the world, with countries like China, Japan, Indonesia, and South Korea dominating the event over the years.
 
• So far, only five countries have won the Uber Cup with **China **the **most successful team**, with 15 titles.
 
• The **2022 edition** was held in **Bangkok**, **Thailand **in which** South Korea beat China** by **3-2**.
 
• 
 The next **edition of 2024** will be held in **Chengdu, China.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Davis Cup** is a **men's tennis tournament** that was **first **held in **1900**.

 
 
• It features national teams from around the world and is one of the most prestigious events in men's tennis.
 
 
 
• **Agha Khan Cup** is **a field hockey tournament** that takes place **in Pakistan.**
 
 
• It was **first **held in **1960 **and is named after the Aga Khan, the spiritual leader of the Ismaili Muslim community.
 
 
 
• **The FIFA World Cup** is a **men's football tournament** that takes place every four years.
 
 
• It features national teams from all over the world and is one of the most-watched sporting events on the planet.
 
• The** 2022 edition** was held in **Qatar**. **Argentina beat France** in **penalties **to win the tournament.
 
• The next **edition of 2026** is in **Canada**, **Mexico**, and **the United States**.
